title: Fail closed unknown required firmware capabilities and stabilize manifest identity

execution.validation_layer: static firmware contracts plus virtual-device Core2 regression
execution.environment: macOS arm64, Python 3.13, Node v22.14.0, patched Xtensa QEMU

checks.name: unknown_required_capability_fail_closed
checks.detail: Merged and WebBurner imports reject unknown required capabilities with exit code 1 and no other validation error.

checks.name: unknown_optional_capability_warning
checks.detail: An unknown optional capability remains a candidate and records a structured warning.

checks.name: device_service_capability_rejection
checks.detail: Device Service returns unsupported_firmware_capability for unknown required capability without creating a firmware/session.

checks.name: manifest_identity_stable
checks.detail: Two identical WebBurner packages under different directory names produce the same artifact SHA and manifest_id.

checks.name: secure_boot_tool_hash_rebind
checks.detail: Current firmware_manifest.py hash is bound by a new 26/26 Secure Boot static evidence run.

checks.name: core2_tool_hash_rebind
checks.detail: Two independent 8x120-second runs pass 8/8 each with current device_service.py hash.

notes: All functional results are virtual-device validation.
Unknown required capabilities now fail closed; unknown optional capabilities remain warnings.
Manifest identity is content-stable and excludes artifact output filename.
The initial Core2 run without M5_CORE2_RADIO_QEMU was an infrastructure control and was not counted.
Full UIFlow2 matrix and physical hardware remain NOT RUN.
